chain.title: Engineer's Hammer
chain.desc: Craft it from two iron ingots, two sticks and string; it forms every IE multiblock and hammers ingots into plates on the crafting grid.

chain.title: Engineer's Manual
chain.desc: Combine a book with a lever for the in-game guide that shows every multiblock layout and machine.

chain.title: Coke Oven
chain.desc: Craft Coke Oven Bricks from clay, bricks and sandstone, stack them into a 3x3x3 cube and click the center face with the Engineer's Hammer.

chain.title: Coal Coke
chain.desc: Bake coal in the Coke Oven; each piece also drips creosote oil into the oven's internal tank.

chain.title: Treated Wood
chain.desc: Surround a bucket of creosote oil with eight planks in a crafting grid to get treated wood planks, the base material for most early IE recipes.

chain.title: Crude Blast Furnace
chain.desc: Craft Blast Bricks from nether bricks, bricks and a magma block, build a 3x3x3 cube and form it with the hammer.

chain.title: Steel
chain.desc: Smelt iron ingots with coal coke in the Blast Furnace; steel unlocks nearly every machine that follows.

chain.title: Kinetic Dynamo
chain.desc: Craft it from iron, an iron mechanical component, redstone and an LV coil; it turns rotation from a wheel on its front into Flux.

chain.title: Windmill
chain.desc: Craft eight windmill blades around an iron ingot and pin the wheel on a Kinetic Dynamo high in the open air for passive early power.

chain.title: LV Wire Coil
chain.desc: Wrap four copper wires around a stick; strung between LV connectors it carries low-voltage power to your first machines.

chain.title: LV Wire Connector
chain.desc: Craft copper ingots with terracotta insulators; place connectors on machines and link them with copper wire coils to move Flux.

chain.title: Engineer's Workbench
chain.desc: Craft it from treated wood slabs, a treated fence, iron and an Engineer's Crafting Table; it assembles blueprint recipes like components and ammo.

chain.title: Mining Drill
chain.desc: Assemble the drill at the Engineer's Workbench, then fit a steel drill head and fill it with diesel or biodiesel to mine 3x3.

chain.title: MV Wire Coil
chain.desc: Alloy gold and silver into electrum and coil its wire around a stick; MV wiring and connectors feed the mid-tier machines.

chain.title: Metal Press
chain.desc: Build the multiblock from steel scaffolding, a conveyor line and a piston, hammer it into shape, and use steel molds to press plates, rods and gears.

chain.title: Crusher
chain.desc: Form the large steel-scaffold multiblock with the hammer; fed with MV power it grinds ores into grit for doubled ingot output.

chain.title: Fermenter
chain.desc: Build this multiblock to ferment sugary crops like sugar cane or potatoes into ethanol, one half of biodiesel.

chain.title: Squeezer
chain.desc: Build the sibling multiblock that presses industrial hemp seeds into plant oil, the other half of biodiesel.

chain.title: Refinery
chain.desc: This steel multiblock mixes ethanol and plant oil into biodiesel fuel for the Diesel Generator and Mining Drill.

chain.title: Diesel Generator
chain.desc: The big steel multiblock burns diesel or biodiesel to produce the large Flux output that HV machines demand.

chain.title: HV Wire Coil
chain.desc: Coil steel and aluminum wire around a stick; HV connectors and relays carry high-voltage power to endgame multiblocks.

chain.title: Arc Furnace
chain.desc: Build this heavy steel multiblock and feed it graphite electrodes; it smelts steel in seconds and mixes alloys directly from dusts.

chain.title: Core Sample Drill
chain.desc: Place and power the drill to extract a core sample revealing which mineral veins run under the chunk.

chain.title: Excavator
chain.desc: The largest IE multiblock: a bucket-wheel digger that chews through surveyed mineral veins for effectively endless ore at huge HV power cost.

notes: All 24 ids set-checked against assets/immersiveengineering/models/item + en_us lang keys of IE 10.2.0-183 (473 verified items). Recipe facts (hammer, cokebrick, blastbrick, treated wood via creosote bucket, dynamo, wire coils, connectors, watermill/windmill, blastfurnace/steel.json) read from data/immersiveengineering/recipes in the jar. Multiblock ids (coke_oven, blast_furnace, metal_press, crusher, fermenter, squeezer, refinery, diesel_generator, arc_furnace, excavator) are the formed multiblock block ids and exist as items with models; a generator using item-detection tasks may prefer checkmark/observation tasks for them. No kill: or dim: entries needed. Nothing dropped.
